description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter class, a custom filter component for Ext JS grids that allows filtering based on a list of options. It extends the existing Ext.ux.grid.filter.Filter class and uses Ext.ux.menu.ListMenu for its menu interface. The class provides methods for initializing, getting/setting filter values, serialization, and validation.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListFilter
classes.description: A grid filter component that supports list-based filtering, utilizing Ext.data.Store or local options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, creating and configuring its menu component, and sets up event handling.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the currently selected value(s) from the list menu.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the selected value(s) in the list menu and triggers update events.

methods.name: isActivatable
methods.description: Determines if the filter is ready to be activated based on its current value.

methods.name: getSerialArgs
methods.description: Serializes the filter's current state into an object suitable for server communication.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Handles check change events in the list menu, triggering delayed update.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Validates if a data record passes the filter criteria based on current selections.
